title: Mindbenders 2016
summary: A quiz for students of classes 8 to 12, held as part of IGNITE 2016.
body: Mindbenders was the quiz held as part of IGNITE 2016, on the evening of 3 December. It was open to students of classes 8 to 12. The poster for the event is with this record.

documents.alt: Poster for Mindbenders, the quiz event held as part of IGNITE 2016 on 3 December.
